svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: EPAC scaffold generator flow
svg.desc: A taxonomy pipeline (extract, enrich, create-initiatives) feeds a manifest-driven assembler that resolves a customer manifest into a canonical model and renders EPAC JSON, Terraform, and Bicep scaffolds, then validates, reviews, and deploys.
